parameters.pairs: every equivalence class with >= 2 members in the canonical store: paraphrase pairs = same-polarity members (H: the 172 complete Tier C PAWS pairs; item-E: 413 = Tier A variants + 180 Tier C pairs), control pairs = same x different polarity (item-E: 468; a measurement column, never a filter); control support of a mapping = classes where it occurs in a control pair but in none of the class's paraphrase pairs
parameters.alignment: exact maximum-common-subgraph: every injective skolem renaming within each stream (e/x/f), maximising identical atoms (term + polarity) then near-identical atoms (same arity, same variables in the same positions, one head or constant differs), first renaming on a tie (ambiguity recorded); greedy assignment above 5,040 renamings (never triggered); eligible atoms = the miner's
parameters.subtrees: the §4.3.1 faithful units instantiated on each side (k 4); a unit maps to the canonical form of its atoms' images (raw when not in the inventory)
parameters.roles: binary heads on an aligned event centre (class links excluded), matched by aligned centre + filler; role-lost when the other side has no atom there
parameters.residue: atoms matched on neither side, keyed by canonical form + the smallest unit instance around them whose other atoms matched; head_on_other_side = attachment slack vs true add/drop
parameters.consistency: support = distinct equivalence classes (never pairs); PASS at >= 3; identity mappings summarised per unit (self / other / lost)
parameters.rules: unit mapping -> two implications into a provisional meta-node (Mn<shared heads>_<AltOrAlt>); role mapping -> minority head rewrites to majority (by occurrence count); residue with a matched context -> the context rewrites to itself without the atom
parameters.pair_view: the per-pair intermediate (align_faithful_pairs.jsonl + .md, one block per pair, added 2026-09-21): the two sentences, the COMMON subgraph (the method's identical atoms, in A's variable names; B renamed through the alignment, B-only variables primed), the differing subgraphs per side (atoms sharing a node symbol the common part does not hold; a symbol the common part holds is an anchor and never merges) ALIGNED across the pair in two tiers — near = the method's own one-substitution match, partial = a reading-only pass among the leftovers (same arity, >= 1 equal argument position holding a skolem unless the heads are equal or both are class links; greedy by equal positions then equal head; never fusing two near-formed groups) — the atoms left over inside aligned groups (A only / B only), and the RESIDUE = subgraphs with no counterpart at all; a view only, the method's outputs byte-identical

outputs: mining/out_h/align_faithful.jsonl / .md / .metta + align_faithful_pairs.jsonl + align_faithful_pairs.md (per-pair intermediate: sentences, common subgraph, aligned differing subgraphs, residue) + align_faithful_notes.md
